annotations.title: Get the link to cancel a 4OVER4 order

description: Gives the link where a customer cancels their own 4OVER4 print order; use it when someone asks to cancel an order. This tool cancels nothing: the customer cancels a job that can still be cancelled on their 4OVER4 orders page, signed in there. To read an order's stage use get_order_details. The order or job number is optional and only names the order in the result. Returns the orders page link. Customer phrases: "cancel order 602074", "I changed my mind on my flyers".

jobId.description: The order or job number the customer wants to cancel, e.g. 602074.

name: get_order_cancel_link

data.description: status "cancel_on_4over4", the order number when given, and the customer's orders page on 4over4.com, where the customer cancels a job that can still be cancelled.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.
